sections.title: Branched columnar cactus
sections.text: This Peruvian cactus grows as a shrub with upright, ribbed, bluish-green stems and can form clumps about 4 m high. Strong spines emerge from woolly areoles. Its white flowers are borne near the stem tips.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: The plate's white funnel-shaped flowers and fleshy red fruit with black seeds agree with published botanical descriptions. The fruit is shown as an organ, but its safety or use as food was not verified.

sections.title: Image match
sections.text: The illustration shows the clustered upright stems, ribbed spiny surfaces, pale flowers and red seeded fruit expected for this species.
